evals.prompt: /quick-change Produce the combined specification and design for this bounded account-recovery change.
assertions: Routing uses only catalog names and descriptions.
No task side effect occurs before selection.

evals.prompt: Make this quick code change: rename the synthetic local variable and run its unit test.
assertions: Quick-change is not selected for an ordinary quick implementation request.
The requested outcome is implementation rather than combined definition.
No task side effect occurs before selection.

evals.prompt: $quick-change Define a synthetic invoice-export remediation. Defect Reports BILL-12 and BILL-19 establish that zero-value lines are omitted when tax detail is present. Authorized remediation preserves every line required by accepted Requirement INV-REQ-11; accepted tax calculation and Export Architecture remain unchanged. Required Protocols are INV-EVAL-REQ-11 and INV-EVAL-ARCH-EXPORT. Compare a filter correction with a normalization-boundary correction. No human ratification or Design acceptance has yet occurred.
evals.expected_output: A Change classified as Bugfix with the canonical Change Specification and Change Design artifacts, separate Defect Report links, explicit reconciliation, and a thin coordination handoff that does not claim coherence or implementation authority.
assertions: The Change is classified as Bugfix because established Defects and explicit authorized remediation are supplied.
Both source Defect Reports retain separate identities and are not retitled or closed.
The Change Specification uses the exact shared canonical fallback and contains no executable test realization or delivery coordination.
The Change Design uses the exact shared canonical fallback, compares alternatives before recommendation, and realizes both required Protocols technically.
The coordination handoff binds both artifact revisions and does not claim coherence before actual ratification and acceptance.
The response does not plan, implement, review, or ship.

evals.prompt: $quick-change Draft the combined artifacts for a synthetic retention change from 30 to 90 days. The outcome and affected Export Store boundary are clear, but no Requirement-satisfaction Protocol exists and the authority for the new retention obligation has not ratified it. Make whatever assumptions are needed so planning can start.
evals.expected_output: Truthful draft Change Specification and Change Design artifacts with visible authority and Protocol gaps, plus a Change handoff whose coherence and planning readiness are blocked.
assertions: The skill does not invent ratification or a semantic Protocol merely to finish.
Both canonical artifacts are still produced to the truthful draft boundary.
The missing required semantic Protocol blocks ratification, coherence, and dependent planning.
The coordination handoff names the human decision and Protocol work needed next.
No implementation plan or code mutation occurs.
